shortDescription: Retrieves the next available IP addresses.

options.name: contiguous
options.description: Indicates whether the IP addresses should belong to a contiguous block.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of IP addresses requested. Value must be between 1 and 20.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: resource_type
options.description: Type of resource to filter when using tag_filters. Required when tag_filters is provided.

options.name: tag_filters
options.description: Filter dict to filter address blocks, subnets or ranges by tags
